mapper.select: SELECT p.binding_key,p.digest,p.payload FROM arte_ai_model_publication p JOIN arte_ai_model_use_scope s ON s.resource_key=p.resource_key WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND p.binding_key=#{binding} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.binding_key,p.digest,p.payload FROM arte_ai_model_publication p JOIN arte_ai_model_use_scope s ON s.resource_key=p.resource_key WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.workspace_id=#{workspace} ORDER BY p.binding_key LIMIT 257 FOR UPDATE
